text: Flee the Facility is a Roblox horror game where one player is the Beast and the rest are Survivors. Survivors must find keycards, unlock a hatch, and escape before the Beast catches them all.
The Beast is the single hunter role each round. The Beast can smash through doors and lockers to catch Survivors, and captured Survivors are strapped to a chair until rescued or the round ends.
Survivors must sneak around the map searching for a hidden keycard, use it to unlock the exit hatch, and escape without being caught by the Beast.
The Facility is the original map in Flee the Facility. It has a maze-like layout with tight corridors, vents, and multiple locker hiding spots.
A captured Survivor strapped to the chair can be freed by another Survivor who reaches them before the timer runs out.
